panels.title: Current healthy monitors (%)
panels.description: Percentage of configured monitors that are fresh, scrapeable and fully healthy. Not-configured dimensions are excluded from their health checks; unevaluated dimensions are not healthy. Shows no value when no observation is available.

targets.expr: (count(((ximiowatch_http_up{application=~"$application"} == 1 and on(monitor, application) (time() - ximiowatch_last_check_timestamp_seconds{application=~"$application"} < (3 * ximiowatch_monitor_interval_seconds{application=~"$application"} + ximiowatch_monitor_timeout_seconds{application=~"$application"} + 5)) and on() (up{job="ximiowatch"} == 1) and on(monitor, application) (ximiowatch_functional_configured{application=~"$application"} == 0 or (ximiowatch_functional_configured{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_functional_evaluated{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_functional_up{application=~"$application"} == 1)) and on(monitor, application) (ximiowatch_performance_configured{application=~"$application"} == 0 or (ximiowatch_performance_configured{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_performance_evaluated{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_performance_up{application=~"$application"} == 1))))) / clamp_min(count(ximiowatch_monitor_interval_seconds{application=~"$application"}), 1)) and on() (count((ximiowatch_http_up{application=~"$application"} and on(monitor, application) (time() - ximiowatch_last_check_timestamp_seconds{application=~"$application"} < (3 * ximiowatch_monitor_interval_seconds{application=~"$application"} + ximiowatch_monitor_timeout_seconds{application=~"$application"} + 5)) and on() (up{job="ximiowatch"} == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Current failing monitors
panels.description: Fresh monitors with a confirmed HTTP, functional or performance failure. Unknown, skipped and not-configured dimensions are not failures.

targets.expr: count((((ximiowatch_http_up{application=~"$application"} == 0 or (ximiowatch_functional_configured{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_functional_evaluated{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_functional_up{application=~"$application"} == 0) or (ximiowatch_performance_configured{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_performance_evaluated{application=~"$application"} == 1 and ximiowatch_performance_up{application=~"$application"} == 0)) and on(monitor, application) (time() - ximiowatch_last_check_timestamp_seconds{application=~"$application"} < (3 * ximiowatch_monitor_interval_seconds{application=~"$application"} + ximiowatch_monitor_timeout_seconds{application=~"$application"} + 5)) and on() (up{job="ximiowatch"} == 1))))

panels.title: Unknown or stale monitors
panels.description: Configured monitors without a recent measurement, or all monitors while the XimioWatch scrape target is down. Last known configuration is retained for 5m.

panels.title: Silent failures (selected range)
panels.description: HTTP available while business/content assertions failed in the selected time range.

panels.title: HTTP, functional and performance history
panels.description: Valid historical observations only; missing observations are shown as gaps, not zero.

panels.title: Historical check-based availability (%)
panels.description: Averaged observations over the selected range. This is historical availability, not current state.

panels.title: Request latency (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of monitored request duration. Only completed HTTP responses are observed.

panels.title: Assertion failures by monitor
panels.description: Count of failed assertions, grouped by monitor and assertion type.

panels.title: Last completed check
panels.description: Timestamp of the last completed check, including failed checks. This is the freshness signal.

panels.title: Last fully healthy check
panels.description: Timestamp of the most recent fully healthy check. Unevaluated required checks do not update this timestamp.
